timeThreshold.label: Repost check window
timeThreshold.helpText: select how far back you want DejaPost to look

enforcementAction.label: Enforcement action
enforcementAction.helpText: Choose what action DejaPost takes when a match is found

imageTolerance.label: Image Reposts Matching Tolerance
imageTolerance.helpText: Higher tolerance allows more variation between image posts (51 = low tolerance for differences / near-exact match required, 99 = high tolerance / loose matching allowed).

videoTolerance.label: Video Reposts Matching Tolerance
videoTolerance.helpText: Higher tolerance allows more variation between video posts (51 = low tolerance for differences / near-exact match required, 99 = high tolerance / loose matching allowed).

textTolerance.label: Text Reposts Matching Tolerance
textTolerance.helpText: Higher tolerance allows more variation between text post titles (51 = low tolerance for differences / near-exact match required, 99 = high tolerance / loose matching allowed).
